_about: The topic index. Each topic gathers the katha that refers to it. The eleven in-depth themes are topics too (their rules live in content/themes/*.md). Rules: 'gurmukhi' terms match at the start of a word ('=' for the whole word only); 'roman' entries are regular expressions matched as whole words in titles; 'series' links whole series; 'angs' links Guru Granth Sahib katha whose recording titles cover those Angs. 'about' is a short editorial note: only well-established facts. Ang ranges are those of the standard 1,430-Ang saroop.

topics.title: Grace (Kirpa, Nadar)
topics.about: In Gurbani, grace (kirpa, nadar) is what completes the seeker's effort.

topics.title: Ardas
topics.about: The Sikh prayer of supplication, said standing before the Guru.

topics.title: Karma and its fruit
topics.about: What our actions bring about, held in Gurbani together with Hukam and grace.

topics.title: Maryada and discipline
topics.about: The discipline and conduct that give a spiritual life its form.

topics.title: Solitude
topics.about: Time apart for remembrance, and its place in a householder's life.

topics.title: Sahaj
topics.about: Natural poise and equanimity, Gurbani's name for the settled, free state.

topics.title: Taking the Guru
topics.about: Accepting the Guru, and what it asks of the disciple.

topics.title: Satsang and the Sadhu
topics.about: The company of the holy, and how to recognise it.

topics.title: Food and devotion
topics.about: How what and how we eat bears on remembrance.

topics.title: Gratitude and ingratitude
topics.about: Thankfulness to the Giver, and the ingratitude Gurbani warns against.

topics.title: Yoga, samadhi and siddhis
topics.about: Patanjali's yoga as Babaji teaches it, read in the light of Gurbani's own teaching on jog.

topics.title: Vedanta
topics.about: Classical texts of Vedanta that Babaji has given katha on, read through Gurmat.

topics.title: Marriage, family and brahmcharya
topics.about: The householder's life, the duties of husband and wife, and restraint.

topics.title: Kirtan and Aarti
topics.about: Singing the Guru's Word, including Aarti and shabads for Sangrand.

topics.title: Questions and answers
topics.about: Babaji answering the sangat's questions, and interviews on Sikh television.

topics.title: Japji Sahib
topics.about: Guru Nanak Dev Ji's opening bani of Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji, Ang 1 to 8.

topics.title: Sukhmani Sahib
topics.about: Guru Arjan Dev Ji's bani of twenty-four ashtapadis in Raag Gauri, Ang 262 to 296.

topics.title: Asa di Var
topics.about: The Var in Raag Asa sung each morning, with saloks of Guru Nanak Dev Ji and Guru Angad Dev Ji, Ang 462 to 475.

topics.title: Anand Sahib
topics.about: Guru Amar Das Ji's song of bliss in Raag Ramkali, Ang 917 to 922.

topics.title: Ramkali Sadd
topics.about: Baba Sundar Ji's account of Guru Amar Das Ji's passing, Ang 923 to 924.

topics.title: Dakhni Oankar
topics.about: Guru Nanak Dev Ji's composition in Raag Ramkali Dakhni, Ang 929 to 938.

topics.title: Sidh Gosht
topics.about: Guru Nanak Dev Ji's dialogue with the Siddh yogis, Ang 938 to 946.

topics.title: Barah Maha and the months
topics.about: The songs of the twelve months: Guru Arjan Dev Ji's in Raag Majh (Ang 133 to 136) and Guru Nanak Dev Ji's in Raag Tukhari (Ang 1107 to 1110).

topics.title: Saloks of Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji
topics.about: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji's fifty-seven saloks near the close of the Granth, Ang 1426 to 1429.

topics.title: Banis of Sri Dasam Granth
topics.about: Banis of Guru Gobind Singh Ji read in Nitnem, such as Jaap Sahib and the Tav Prasad Savaiye.

topics.title: Bhai Gurdas Ji's Vaaran and Kabit
topics.about: The Vaaran and Kabit Savaiye of Bhai Gurdas Ji, scribe of the Adi Granth.

topics.title: Bhai Nand Lal Ji's ghazals
topics.about: Persian ghazals of love for the Guru by Bhai Nand Lal Ji, poet at Guru Gobind Singh Ji's court.

topics.title: Sikh history in katha
topics.about: The lives of the Gurus as told in the Granths of Kavi Santokh Singh and in Babaji's jeevan katha.

topics.title: Guru Nanak Dev Ji
topics.about: The first Guru (1469 to 1539).

topics.title: Guru Amar Das Ji
topics.about: The third Guru, author of Anand Sahib.

topics.title: Guru Tegh Bahadur Ji
topics.about: The ninth Guru.

topics.title: Guru Gobind Singh Ji
topics.about: The tenth Guru, who created the Khalsa and passed Guruship to the Granth.

topics.title: Baba Sri Chand Ji
topics.about: Guru Nanak Dev Ji's elder son, revered as the founder of the Udasi tradition.

topics.title: Sant Jawala Singh Ji
topics.about: Founder of Dera Sant Ghar, Harkhowal (1889 to 1957).

topics.title: The mahapurakhs of Hoti Mardan
topics.about: Sant Karam Singh Ji and Sant Aiya Singh Ji of Dera Hoti Mardan, from whom the Dera's lineage descends.

topics.title: Mahapurakhs of the Sikh Raaj era
topics.about: Baba Sahib Singh Bedi of Una Sahib, Baba Bhag Singh of Kuri, and Baba Bir Singh, Baba Khuda Singh and Baba Maharaj Singh of Naurangabad.

topics.title: Sangrand
topics.about: The first day of each month of the Punjabi calendar, marked with the shabad of that month from the Barah Maha.

topics.title: Amavas
topics.about: The new-moon day. Several of Babaji's Amavas divans were given at Gurdwara Sri Ber Sahib, Sultanpur Lodhi.

topics.title: Gurpurbs and barsis
topics.about: Katha on the Gurpurbs of the Gurus, at barsis of mahapurakhs and at annual samagams.
